answers.reason: The elected student representative represents only one faculty and holds no university-wide office.
The budget planning round is a central administrative body with no seats for faculty-level student representatives.
Facultyappointment committees typically include a seat for the faculty's elected student representative to evaluate teaching suitability.
The elected student representative is elected by the faculty's students specifically to speak for them in the faculty council.
As the body advising the faculty council on teaching, the study commission includes the faculty's elected student representative.
Standard university regulations provide a seat for a student representative on the faculty's examination board.
Allocating internal research grants does not involve student representation.
As a holder of a faculty-level representative office on teaching matters, the student representative may take part in subordinate working groups revising study modules.
Equipment procurement is an administrative and staff matter without seats for student representatives.
Planning the orientation week for new students falls squarely within the remit of the faculty's elected student representative.
